messages:
Rita (People Ops): Posting the live Q&A notes from today's all-hands on hybrid expectations, offsites, and travel reimbursements. Keeping answers short94ask follow-ups here.
Omar (Facilities): Quick: will desk reservations be blocked for whole days or half-days now? We had people complaining about full-day holds.
Rita (People Ops): We're switching to half-day blocks starting May 1 to improve availability. Facilities will publish the new slots.
Ishan (SRE): For on-call teams that need physical access to the data center, are there additional office days required?
Hannah (CEO): If a role has safety/ops constraints (e.g., data center access), managers should list required in-office days on the job page. We won't change existing security access rules.
Lea (Product): Offsite budget question: are meals for external partners paid from offsite budget or from client entertainment? Want to avoid double-billing.
Rita (People Ops): Partners at offsites are billed under "client entertainment". Internal-only offsite meals should use offsite budget. Finance will add an "offsite-internal" tag.
Ishan (SRE): Travel reimbursement cap for coworking spaces? Sometimes folks need a quiet place to work when visiting a city.
travel-bot: Policy excerpt: coworking reimbursable up to $50/day with prior manager approval. Add "coworking" tag in Expensify.
Omar (Facilities): If a small team wants to reserve a conference room at HQ for a multi-day focus sprint, what's the process?
Rita (People Ops): Use the "focus-sprint" form on the intranet. There's a $500 per-team allowance for snacks and local transport for 2-3 day sprints. Submit 7 days before.
Lea (Product): Will managers be reminded to publish team schedules? Need that for event planning.
Rita (People Ops): Yes, automated reminder emails go out to managers on Apr 15. We'll include a schedule template.
Ishan (SRE): And if travel costs exceed estimates due to last-minute changes?
Hannah (CEO): Approve exceptions case-by-case. Team leads can request top-up from People Ops; Finance will evaluate on a rolling basis.
Rita (People Ops): Action items: 1) Facilities to roll out half-day hoteling by May 1; 2) People Ops to publish focus-sprint form and schedule template by Apr 20; 3) Finance to add "offsite-internal" category and update coworking cap by Apr 12. Will update here when live.
Lea (Product): Thanks 44d 44d.
Ishan (SRE): Appreciated, very clear.
Rita (People Ops): If anything missing, DM me or reply here. Thanks everyone!
